propositions: verify.overlap_enabled config key and REBAR_VERIFY_OVERLAP_ENABLED env var are undocumented and poorly named (refer to internal mechanism 'overlap' rather than user-visible output 'duplicate ticket suggestions')
The feature gate for cross-ticket duplicate suggestion must be renamed to verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets to accurately convey its advisory nature and output product
Existing project configs and environment variables using the old names must continue working via permanent aliases (no scheduled removal date) to avoid breaking live deployments
Both the TOML key alias (via _ALIASES dict and coerce_sparse) and env var alias (via _LEGACY_ENV_ALIASES and env_overrides) must be implemented using existing infrastructure
docs/config.md lacks any inventory entry for the old or new key despite the feature spending LLM tokens proportional to tracker size, creating an operator documentation gap
When both legacy and canonical names are set (in TOML or environment), the canonical value must win and legacy must be silently dropped or not warned about duplicately
